sloka: अपश्यत्स यमं तत्र देवमग्निपुरस्कृतम् ।विधानमुपतिष्ठन्तं प्राणिनो यस्य यादृशम् ।। ७.२१.२ ॥
transliteration: apaśyatsa yamaṁ tatra devamagnipuraskṛtam ।vidhānamupatiṣṭhantaṁ prāṇino yasya yādṛśam ।। 7.21.2 ॥

translations.english: There, Narada saw the god Yama, honored by fire, administering the fate of all beings as it was ordained for each.
